name: duels2d
description: Duels2D is a modular, zero-player 2D physics simulator designed for recording high-retention YouTube Shorts and TikTok content. Fighters clash inside a mobile-friendly 9:16 aspect ratio arena, bouncing off walls with perfect elasticity, exchanging damage, and deploying unique weaponry. The simulator features dynamic hit flashes, visual particle sparks, custom sprite crops, fighter-specific sound pools, and an in-game command developer console.
